description: Auto/Manual Resolution Duality doctrine (PROPOSED) — drafted 2026-07-08 at Jordan's request (his Total-War auto/manual framing). designs/architecture/auto_manual_resolution_duality_v1.md: every contested event has two resolution FIDELITIES of the same conflict — AUTO-RESOLVE (algorithmic, aggregate-state, one step) and PLAY-IT-OUT (a full personal-scale scene) — and the zoom in/out protocol (scale_transitions §4) IS the toggle. The Parliamentary vote wired in ED-SC-0006/0007 (ECHO_TRANSPORT default ON) is the first auto-resolver; the promoted personal contest kernel is its played counterpart. KEY CONSTRAINT: the two must be distributionally consistent on matched inputs (E[auto]~=E[played]) — an EXPLOIT-PREVENTION requirement (no mode-shopping) whose acceptance oracle is a NEW parity harness between parliamentary_bridge and the personal kernel. Reframes ED-SC-0011 as the ZOOM-IN EXPANSION (a party-derivation calibrated to the auto-resolver, parity harness = acceptance gate) -- converting the previously-undefined derivation into a well-posed problem. Escalation policy: default-auto / opt-in-play, stakes-gated at scale_transitions 4.3.2. Open forks (needs_jordan, NOT ratified by merge): FORK-A one-engine-vs-two, FORK-B escalation predicate, FORK-C calibration tolerance, FORK-D player-layer choice-vs-forced. Per ED-1094 review+merge ratifies the DOCTRINE (duality + calibration constraint + ED-SC-0011 reframe); the forks stay open. Does NOT implement the harness or change the auto-resolver; the provisional derivation stays retunable (not canon). · REVISED + RULED 2026-07-08 (Jordan: "specific events on a slate" steer + "resolve A/B/D, keep C open"). Doctrine reworked to lead with the SCENE SLATE as the spine — player_agency_v30 §4 already specifies it (deterministic, priority-ranked, settlement-anchored, Conviction-biased set of SPECIFIC events; 3–5 scene-action budget; "opportunities not pursued resolve through NPC AI without player input" = the auto-resolve, already canon). The table is internally incoherent under its own 'track-distance weighted' framing: Compromise spans Tracks 4-6 with the balanced midpoint at Track 5, yet Track 6 (nearer the high-Decisive threshold of 7) gets the EVEN 50/50 split while the Track-5 midpoint gets a non-even 55/45 -- a monotone-in-track-number schedule, not a distance-from-decisive one, producing a perverse majority-claimant incentive (a stronger showing at Track 6 yields the majority claimant LESS than at Track 4). The sole citation ED-762 resolves to an unrelated '[PROVISIONAL] spec-progression' flat-ledger entry carrying '_migration_flag: ID-CONFLICT' and an orphaned '_migration_alt' ('succession contest compromise outcome (SS7.2.1) gains track-distance weighting (track 4 = 6...') -- i.e. the real rationale was a lost migration remnant, never re-filed. Proposed remediation: re-derive the split schedule coherently (even split at the Track-5 midpoint; majority-favoured toward whichever Decisive threshold is nearer) and re-file the rationale. File jointly with formula finding F-A13 (same defect). Surfaced by the 2026-07-13 multi-agent audit (mechanic_audit G-2 / F-A13).

FORK B (Jordan) - what is the anti-collapse device? The adjudicator armature is NOT one: all four Styles produce IDENTICAL state changes (an additive _advance gain) differing only in the magnitude of one upside-only scalar (<=0.5 sigma, armature.py:336) against a hidden judge vector - precisely Constraint C1's failure signature (manoeuvres differing only in damage output, upload 1 SS3.1). Once Appraise reveals the dominant axis (Success band, appraise.py:168-170) the Style choice is a solved lookup and an AI opponent grinds the residual to its mean. Compounding: the orientation bit is DOMINATED contest-wide, not merely in the single-exchange corner ED-1060 addressed - a Revealing win yields E[(m-1)+|win]~2.1 immediately plus strain plus initiative, an Obscuring win yields 0 movement and a marker worth ~1.2 at exchange 1 and exactly 0 at the last, so Revealing dominates at every resistance value and the 2x2 Style grid collapses to Precedent/Vision - the Burning Wheel Point/Dismiss collapse the design cites Burning Wheel to avoid, reproduced with more rules. Worse, CR5's COST half is wired while the Doubt Marker (its entire upside) is not, so Obscuring currently ships as pure downside. The warrant x attack table (upload 1 P7 / upload 3 SS6.2) differs STRUCTURALLY - Undermine deletes a premise, Rebut stacks a counter-claim for weighing, Undercut severs the inference - so the correct verb varies with the opponent's observable claim structure per claim, the only anti-collapse shape that works with no GM and an AI opponent. The kernel is ~80% there (EvidenceItem carries ground+appeal+hidden weight; rebut exists behind a venue flag); adding a warrant field and splitting rebut into three kinds extends existing types rather than adding a system. CARRIED CAVEAT (upload 1's own A1): the table anti-collapses only if the authored claim corpus is warrant-diverse - it is a content dependency wearing a mechanic's clothes; adopt the 40%-per-attack-type authoring invariant as a script check BEFORE writing claims. Audit recommendation: warrant x attack, decisively - CONDITIONAL ON THE SWEEP. FALSIFIER (not run): AI-vs-AI best-response sweeps across judge/venue distributions; if Style-pick entropy under the armature alone stays high (no Style >40% pick rate) this verdict is wrong, and if attack-pick under the warrant table collapses past 40% on the shipped corpus the table fails its own promise too. Do not ratify without the sweep.

CONSOLIDATION/INTEGRATION PROGRAMME CIP-0..CIP-10, precedent-grounded (proposals/social_contest_consolidation_integration_v1.md). Four read-only Fable 5 precedent lenses (record spine / argument loop / opposition+authority / consolidation+legibility) reasoning over acclaimed videogame and boardgame precedent; Opus synthesis. GOVERNING RESULT: two configurations of one engine are distinct scenes iff (i) a competent player's best action sequence differs -- the parameters change POLICY not expected value -- and (ii) the player can tell before acting which configuration they are in. Fail (i) = reskin; fail (ii) = noise. Consequence: upload 1's Constraint C1 (verb collapse) and the thrice-flagged interface gap are THE SAME PRINCIPLE from two sides, which is why legibility is half the variety mechanism and not polish. THREE CORRECTIONS TO OUR OWN PRIOR DOCUMENTS: (C-1) the audit's anti-collapse principle ('options must differ in what they change, not in magnitude') is necessary but NOT sufficient -- Burning Wheel's manoeuvres did differ in what they changed and collapsed anyway because the win condition cashes every state change into one currency; corrected principle adds 'and the close contains no common scalar into which all verb effects convert at fixed rates'. (C-2) our kernel does NOT already satisfy this: every WinCondition reads s.adv only (resolver.py:52-145) and Standing/Room feed Readiness which multiplies into the gain that becomes adv (:314-316) -- one scoring scalar plus one orthogonal terminal (the fault/clinch catalogue, :438-442), which is the seed of a second currency. (C-4) 'no opposition model' undersold what exists -- the Church action chain (faction_action.py:294-312) is a fixed ordered agenda and faction.fixed_lean:20 is a red line; what is missing is memory, patience and a voiced reason, not belief. KEY REFRAME (Lens D): the sameness risk of consolidating 8 proceedings onto one engine is ALREADY REALIZED and not by the config rows -- when every output is a stat delta, Church Tribunal and Guild Arbitration ARE the same scene regardless of resolution bespokeness, so distinct emittable RECORD types are the identity mechanism and CIP-1 makes consolidation safe rather than risky. Ten proposals with risk classes EVIDENCED / CONDITIONAL / NOVEL, sequencing in 5 waves, and a falsifier each.

AMENDS RATIFIED DOCTRINE -- refine the Auto/Manual Resolution Duality parity constraint (CIP-9b). auto_manual_resolution_duality_v1.md carries the load-bearing constraint E[auto] ~= E[played] for exploit prevention. Precedent (Lens D) says the intent is right but the BASELINE is underspecified: in Football Manager a watched match diverges from an unwatched one exactly by the manager's live interventions, and that divergence is legitimate -- it is the SKILL PREMIUM expressed through the same verb set [MED]. Proposed refinement: the fork-C parity harness measures E[auto] against AI-vs-AI PLAYED, not against expert play, and treats player skill above that baseline as a feature rather than a calibration violation. Our own canon arguably already means this ('opportunities not pursued resolve through NPC AI without player input'). Two supporting precedent notes: (a) Football Manager achieves parity BY CONSTRUCTION (views of one simulation) rather than by calibration -- the shape fork A already chose, and drifting back to calibrated-separate-engines is the Total War failure mode where the community finds and exploits the seam [MED]; (b) XCOM 2 ships NO auto-resolve [HIGH] because its outcome surface is high-dimensional and a fabricated permadeath is unacceptable -- so auto-resolve is viable only where the outcome surface is LOW-dimensional. Our five-band close + echo deltas + record emissions qualifies; the constraint to preserve is that a played contest must not start generating rich per-scene state, or honest auto-resolution becomes impossible. NULL: no published game states an E[auto]~=E[played] constraint explicitly that Lens C/D could name -- the formulation appears to be ours; precedent supports the intent but cannot confirm the tolerance shape, so fork C stays genuinely open. Needs Jordan because it amends a RATIFIED doctrine rather than proposing new design.
